limitations: Conference poster evidence; candidate transcription, not a peer-reviewed full-cohort report or raw-data release.
The 20 sheep were maintained on FLI for at least 6 days; the denominator of all FLI starts and unsuccessful early transfers is not reported.
Coating group sizes are n=6, n=7, and n=7; the poster does not report sample size at each IL-6 timepoint or per-animal trajectories.
The plot states Median ± IQR, but exact median and quartile values are not printed; the displayed y-axis has nonuniform tick spacing and no stated transform. No concentration points were digitized.
The poster reports a PMEA trend toward lower IL-6 but gives no p-value, effect estimate, or uncertainty for the coating comparison; do not interpret this as a confirmed effect.
No transition-to-neonatal or post-support functional outcomes are reported in this poster.

This 20-animal poster may overlap the separate 29-animal EP09.31 support cohort and four EP09.22 transition cases; no animal/experiment crosswalk or study dates are reported, so do not pool counts or assume independent replication.
